purpose: Phase-8A resistance context profiles per species + tumour model. Each profile is the baseline resistance state a simulation begins from, plus the mechanisms / subpopulations / tolerance-adaptive-acquired states / persistence-washout-rechallenge rules that context SUPPORTS. The frozen package has NO direct resistance / washout / rechallenge dataset for this tripterine-NLC context (Chen 2012 measured tumour RESPONSE, not resistance), so every active profile is a LABELLED prediction (general tumour drug-resistance biology) - never experimental. Species/model/formulation are strictly isolated; no silent transfer. Baseline fractions are SCHEMATIC predicted composition; no cell count, IC50, fold-resistance, mutation, or time-to-resistance is stated (all NOT_REPORTED).

mouse_b16bl6_resistance.uncertainty: Baseline heterogeneity and every resistance tendency are inferred from general melanoma drug-resistance biology; the frozen package has NO direct resistance measurement for this B16BL6 tripterine-NLC context. All fractions are schematic predicted composition; all quantitative resistance endpoints are NOT_REPORTED.
mouse_b16bl6_resistance.limitations: No IC50 / fold-resistance / mutation identity / time-to-resistance / persister fraction (all NOT_REPORTED). Immune-associated resistance UNAVAILABLE (Phase 7C not implemented).

human_skin_resistance.uncertainty: A PREDICTIVE, exploratory human resistance context with its OWN distinct baseline fractions and states - NOT copied from mouse. Not validated for human clinical response; abstract resistance tendencies only.
human_skin_resistance.human_translation_warning: This resistance context is a mechanistic, exploratory prediction and is not validated for human clinical resistance, treatment failure, or progression.
human_skin_resistance.limitations: Predictive only; no human resistance measurement; all quantitative endpoints NOT_REPORTED. Immune-associated resistance UNAVAILABLE (Phase 7C not implemented).

rat_skin_resistance.uncertainty: Rat data support skin permeation only; no rat tumour resistance dataset. No resistance state is generated from skin-permeation evidence alone.
rat_skin_resistance.reason: no rat tumour resistance evidence -> NOT_REPORTED

context_rules.modifier_not_replacement: Resistance evaluates only resistance state + an advisory response modifier; it never calculates release/diffusion/penetration/vascular flow/immune activation/signaling/transcription/translation/apoptosis commitment/raw tumour burden, and never mutates a previous engine.
context_rules.species_isolation: Mouse / human / rat resistance profiles are strictly isolated; no context transfers silently - a cross-species use requires a CROSS_SPECIES_PREDICTION label with rationale + uncertainty increase.
context_rules.model_isolation: B16 / B16-F10 / B16BL6 / human melanoma resistance are never merged; cross-model transfer requires CROSS_TUMOR_PREDICTION.
context_rules.formulation_isolation: Free-drug resistance is never transferred to nanoparticle delivery without a FORMULATION_PREDICTION label.
context_rules.not_reported_stays: Rat stays NOT_REPORTED; human is a labelled predictive-exploratory mode.
context_rules.no_experimental_tier: Resistance has NO experimental tier for this context; every active relationship is a labelled prediction (there is no direct resistance dataset in the frozen package).
context_rules.immune_unavailable: Immune-associated resistance is UNAVAILABLE because Phase 7C (immune microenvironment) is not implemented in this build.
